description: Create and submit a WhatsApp message template to Meta for approval. Text templates only (header text, body with {{1}} variables, footer) — add buttons in the app. The template is NOT usable until Meta approves it (check with list_templates). Submitting consumes the store’s Meta template allowance.

category.description: UTILITY = transactional (order/shipping), MARKETING = promos, AUTHENTICATION = codes.

headerText.description: Optional short bold header above the body.

message.description: Body text. Use {{1}}, {{2}} for personalised values.

name.description: Friendly template name (a Meta-safe id is derived from it).

variableSamples.description: Example values per variable number, e.g. {"1":"Sara"} — Meta reviews with these.

name: create_template

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
